schedule: before 4am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: The 3-day gate matches `exclude-newer = "3 days"` in pyproject.toml: without it Renovate proposes releases that `uv lock` is not allowed to resolve yet. Digest and pin updates carry no release timestamp, so the gate would block them forever; Renovate does not support minimumReleaseAge for pin updates either.

lockFileMaintenance has no release timestamp of its own -- it is a whole-lockfile refresh, not a single package bump -- so under the default timestamp-required behaviour the age gate never clears and silently disables the automerge above.

One weekly PR for every non-major update, across pip, pre-commit and GitHub Actions. Majors stay separate PRs so none of them rots unnoticed. Security updates are unaffected: vulnerabilityAlerts defaults to no schedule and no group.
Major updates can change behaviour that CI does not cover, so they wait for a human even when CI passes.
ruff is pinned twice (dev dependency group and pre-commit hook); move both together.
pyright is pinned twice (dev dependency group and pre-commit hook); move both together.

maturin is pinned twice (build-system in pyproject.toml and maturin-version in release.yml, which the github-actions manager reads); move both together. maturin-version is written without a leading v, which maturin-action adds itself, so Renovate can look it up on PyPI.
release-plz decides what gets released, so new versions of it get their own PR and a human review instead of joining the automerged weekly group.

Python versions move by hand: requires-python, .python-version and uv.lock together. Renovate's pep621 manager reads `requires-python` as an updatable version and jumps its range past what uv.lock resolves for, so its own `uv lock` artifact update fails.
Same for the interpreter file itself: a lone `.python-version` bump runs ahead of requires-python and uv.lock, and `uv run` refuses to start. Renovate reads `.python-version` with its pyenv manager.
Same for the Python version that workflows install with actions/setup-python: a bump past requires-python makes `uv sync` fail in CI.

customManagers.description: release-plz's version is pinned as an input of release-plz/action in release.yml, which no built-in manager reads. It is pinned separately from the action, so the binary only changes through its own reviewed PR.
